column1: # G3-14 SPECIFICITY fixture — the combined-clean parse rate sits EXACTLY AT the
# configured floor, so the declared `>=` comparator must return PASS.
# This fixture is the boundary case ON PURPOSE. A gate whose specificity arm sits
# comfortably above the floor cannot tell a correct `>=` from an incorrect `>`;
# only the at-floor row makes that mutation observable, which is why the seeded-
# failure arm for G3-14 is exactly `>=` -> `>` against this file.
#   parse_status     clean | failed | deferred  (deferred is EXCLUDED from the
# Determinate denominator = 9 clean + 1 failed = 10 -> rate 0.90 == floor 0.90.
# A deferred body. If it were counted the denominator would be 11 and the rate
# 0.818, flipping this fixture to BREACH — so its presence is what asserts the
# deferral-exclusion rule rather than assuming it.
# Group-2 and group-3 rows. Both must stay out of numerator AND denominator; the
# group-3 count is reported as the denominator-coverage co-gate figure.
